title: Writing (articles, blog, newsletter)
description: A folder per piece; stages from idea to publication; words and reading time; editing, proofreading, another tone, shortening, SEO, splitting into posts.
folderHint: A folder where every subfolder is an article or an issue

commands.title: Edit
commands.task: Edit the text: remove filler, officialese, repetition and clichés, simplify long sentences, keep the meaning, the facts and the author's voice. First the whole edited text. Then a list of the 5–10 most important edits as «before → after → why».

commands.title: Proofread
commands.task: Find spelling, punctuation and grammar mistakes, typos and agreement errors. Do not change the style or wording. Give the corrected text and after it a list of the corrections.

commands.title: Another tone
commands.task: Rewrite the text in this tone: {text} (for example: friendlier, stricter, with humour, for experts, for beginners). Same meaning, facts and structure.

commands.title: Shorten / expand
commands.task: Make a version of the text of about {text} words. When shortening, keep the essentials and the strongest examples. When expanding, add explanations and examples on the topic, not filler, and no new facts without a «check» mark.

commands.title: SEO
commands.task: Suggest: a search title (up to 60 characters), a meta description (up to 155 characters), 5–8 key phrases the text really answers, and 3 ideas for missing H2 subheadings. Do not change the text itself.

commands.title: Split into posts
commands.task: Turn the text into a series of posts for {platform}: 3–5 posts, each standing on its own with its own idea from the text, a hooking first line and a call to action at the end. Respect the platform's format (length, hashtags, emoji — in moderation). Number them and say in which order to publish.
